sloka: मात्मनः सम्ततिम् द्राक्षीत्स्वेषु दारेषु दुःखितः ।आयुः समग्रमप्राप्य यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-३६॥
transliteration: mātmanaḥ samtatim drākṣītsveṣu dāreṣu duḥkhitaḥ ।āyuḥ samagramaprāpya yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-36॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother live an entire life of anguish without begetting children through his wife or without seeing his own children
